# SPECIFICATION: REWARDS EARNING RULES DISPLAY

## CURRENT STATE SUMMARY:
Today, customers earn cashback through accelerated (merchant-specific with caps), standard, and exclusion rules applied at presentment. When customers contact support asking "why did I get X% cashback?", agents manually check merchant configurations, MCC codes, and monthly caps across multiple systems. This generates 800 monthly tickets because the earning logic is invisible to customers in-app.

---

## SCOPE:

### IN SCOPE:
- Display cashback rate earned on each transaction in transaction detail view
- Show reason code for cashback rate (accelerated/standard/excluded/capped)
- Link to merchant-specific earning rules when accelerated rate applies
- Display monthly accelerated rewards cap status and remaining balance
- Show cashback reversal reason when transaction is refunded
- Tooltip explaining why standard rate applied instead of accelerated rate

### OUT OF SCOPE:
- Predictive cashback calculator before transaction — requires real-time MID/TID lookup infrastructure not yet built
- Historical changes to earning rules — audit trail exists in ops systems, customer-facing history adds complexity without proportional support ticket reduction
- Customizable cashback alerts/notifications — notification framework redesign is separate roadmap item, this PRD focuses on post-transaction transparency
- Editing or disputing cashback rates — dispute flow requires separate fraud/ops workflow integration beyond this feature's scope

---

## FUNCTIONAL USE CASES:

### Use Case 1: View Accelerated Cashback Earning Details (Happy Path)
**Actor:** Primary cardholder  
**Precondition:** User completed a transaction at accelerated merchant, cashback posted at presentment, monthly cap not exceeded  

**User Story:** As a Pixel cardholder, I want to see why I earned 5% cashback on my Swiggy transaction so that I understand my rewards and trust the system is working correctly.

**Steps:**
1. User opens Jupiter app and navigates to Transactions tab
2. User taps on specific Swiggy transaction showing "₹50 cashback earned"
3. System displays transaction detail screen with expandable "Cashback Details" section
4. User taps "Cashback Details" section
5. System shows: "5% accelerated rate • Swiggy partner offer • ₹8,500 remaining this month toward ₹10,000 cap"
6. User taps "View offer details" link
7. System displays bottom sheet with full accelerated earning rule: merchant name, rate, monthly cap, validity period

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given user views transaction with accelerated cashback, when transaction detail loads, then "Cashback Details" section displays with collapse/expand chevron icon
- Given user expands Cashback Details, when section opens, then system displays: cashback percentage, earning rule type (accelerated/standard/excluded), merchant name if accelerated, and cap status if applicable
- Given accelerated earning rule has monthly cap, when Cashback Details displays, then remaining balance shows as "₹X remaining this month toward ₹Y cap" with progress bar at 0-100%
- Given user taps "View offer details" link, when bottom sheet opens, then sheet displays: merchant/category name, cashback rate, cap amount, cap period (monthly/quarterly), offer validity dates, and T&C link
- Given transaction earned standard rate at non-accelerated merchant, when Cashback Details displays, then system shows "Standard rate • 1% on all purchases" without cap information

**Failure State AC:**
- Given cashback calculation is pending (transaction in auth state), when user views transaction, then Cashback Details shows "Cashback pending • Will be credited at settlement" with info icon
- Given system cannot retrieve earning rule metadata, when Cashback Details section loads, then display "Cashback rate: X% • Details unavailable" with retry option

**Priority:** P0

---

### Use Case 2: View Cashback Exclusion Reason (Edge Case)
**Actor:** Primary cardholder  
**Precondition:** User completed transaction at excluded merchant category (fuel/wallet load), no cashback earned  

**User Story:** As a Pixel cardholder, I want to understand why I didn't earn cashback on my fuel purchase so that I don't waste time contacting support.

**Steps:**
1. User notices ₹2,000 fuel transaction shows "₹0 cashback earned"
2. User taps transaction to view details
3. User expands "Cashback Details" section
4. System displays: "No cashback earned • Fuel purchases excluded from rewards program"
5. User taps "Why?" info icon
6. System shows bottom sheet listing all excluded categories: Fuel, Wallet loads, Cash advances, EMI conversions, Rent payments

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given transaction is at excluded MCC, when Cashback Details displays, then system shows "No cashback earned • [Category] excluded from rewards program" with info icon
- Given user taps info icon on exclusion message, when bottom sheet opens, then sheet displays complete list of excluded categories with "Learn more" link to rewards T&C
- Given transaction is wallet load to Paytm/PhonePe, when exclusion reason displays, then specific message reads "Wallet loads excluded from rewards program"
- Given transaction is fuel purchase, when exclusion reason displays, then specific message reads "Fuel purchases excluded from rewards program"

**Failure State AC:**
- Given transaction MCC is excluded but earning rule service returns error, when Cashback Details loads, then display "No cashback earned • Exclusion rules apply" without specific category until service recovers

**Priority:** P0

---

### Use Case 3: View Cashback Reversal After Refund (Failure Scenario)
**Actor:** Primary cardholder  
**Precondition:** User received refund for previously rewarded transaction, cashback reversed, rewards balance went negative  

**User Story:** As a Pixel cardholder, I want to see why my rewards balance decreased after a refund so that I understand the reversal is legitimate and not an error.

**Steps:**
1. User notices rewards balance decreased from 5,000 to 4,500 points
2. User navigates to Rewards transaction history
3. User sees "-500 points • Swiggy refund reversal" entry
4. User taps reversal entry
5. System displays detail screen showing: original transaction date, original cashback earned, refund date, reversed amount, linked original transaction ID
6. User taps "View original transaction"
7. System navigates to original Swiggy purchase showing refund status and cashback reversal note

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given cashback was reversed due to refund, when user views reversal in rewards history, then entry displays: negative point value, "Refund reversal" label, merchant name, and reversal date
- Given user taps cashback reversal entry, when detail screen loads, then system shows: original transaction date and amount, original cashback earned, refund processing date, reversed cashback amount, and "View original transaction" link
- Given rewards balance went negative after reversal, when user views rewards balance, then system displays negative balance in red with info icon explaining "Negative balance due to refund • Will be recovered from future earnings or billed after 2 statement cycles"
- Given user has negative rewards balance for 2+ statement cycles, when user views rewards balance, then system shows warning: "Negative balance of ₹X will be billed to your account on [statement date]"

**Failure State AC:**
- Given original transaction link is broken (transaction purged from 90-day history), when user taps "View original transaction", then system displays error message "Original transaction details no longer available • Refund processed on [date]" with support contact option

**Priority:** P1

---

## NON-FUNCTIONAL USE CASES:

- **Performance - Transaction Detail Load Time**: Cashback Details section must load within 800ms of transaction detail screen render, with earning rule metadata cached for 24 hours per merchant  
  **Acceptance:** 95th percentile load time ≤800ms measured via zchs_cashback_details_loaded event with latency_ms parameter

- **Performance - Cap Balance Calculation**: Monthly accelerated cap remaining balance must calculate in real-time without blocking UI render, with stale data tolerance of 5 minutes  
  **Acceptance:** Cap balance API returns within 300ms or uses cached value with "as of [timestamp]" disclaimer if service timeout occurs

- **Security - Earning Rule Visibility**: Cashback rate and merchant earning rules displayed must match user's card product variant (Turbo/Pixel), with no cross-product data leakage  
  **Acceptance:** Earning rule API validates card_id and product_type before returning rules; security test confirms user A cannot view user B's earning rules via parameter manipulation

- **Accessibility - Screen Reader Support**: All cashback detail components must be navigable via TalkBack/VoiceOver with descriptive labels for rates, caps, and exclusions  
  **Acceptance:** Accessibility audit confirms all interactive elements have contentDescription (Android) / accessibilityLabel (iOS), and cashback amounts announce as "X rupees cashback earned at Y percent rate"

- **Reliability - Graceful Degradation**: If earning rule service is unavailable, transaction detail must still display cashback amount with generic "Details temporarily unavailable" message  
  **Acceptance:** When earning rule API returns 5xx error, UI displays cashback amount with retry option, and zchs_cashback_details_failure event fires with error_code parameter

---

## METRICS IMPACT:

- **Metric name:** Support tickets tagged "cashback inquiry" or "rewards calculation"  
  **Current baseline:** 800 tickets/month (check with CS ops for exact tag)  
  **Expected impact:** 60% reduction to ~320 tickets/month within 60 days of release  
  **Owner:** Customer Support Ops team

- **Metric name:** Transaction detail screen engagement rate (% of users who tap transaction to view details)  
  **Current baseline:** Unknown — check with analytics team for zchs_transaction_detail_viewed event frequency  
  **Expected impact:** 15-20% increase as users explore cashback explanations  
  **Owner:** Product Analytics team

- **Metric name:** Cashback Details section expansion rate (% of transaction detail views where user expands section)  
  **Current baseline:** New metric — no baseline  
  **Expected impact:** Target 40% expansion rate in first 30 days, indicating feature discoverability  
  **Owner:** Product Analytics team

---

## NEW METRICS TO TRACK:

- **Metric name:** Cashback Details view rate  
  **Definition:** (zchs_cashback_details_viewed events) / (zchs_transaction_detail_viewed events) × 100  
  **Target:** ≥40% within 30 days of release  
  **Owner:** Product Analytics team

- **Metric name:** Accelerated offer detail view rate  
  **Definition:** (zchs_accelerated_offer_viewed events) / (zchs_cashback_details_viewed events where earning_type=accelerated) × 100  
  **Target:** ≥25% indicating users explore merchant-specific offers  
  **Owner:** Product Analytics team

- **Metric name:** Cashback exclusion info view rate  
  **Definition:** (zchs_exclusion_info_viewed events) / (zchs_cashback_details_viewed events where earning_type=excluded) × 100  
  **Target:** ≥50% indicating users understand why no cashback earned  
  **Owner:** Product Analytics team

- **Metric name:** Negative balance warning view rate  
  **Definition:** (zchs_negative_balance_warning_viewed events) / (users with negative rewards balance) × 100  
  **Target:** 100% — all users with negative balance must see warning  
  **Owner:** Product Analytics team

---

## REPORTS & EXTRACTS IMPACT:

**New reports needed:**
- Daily Cashback Transparency Engagement Report: aggregates Cashback Details views by earning type (accelerated/standard/excluded), merchant category, and cap status
- Weekly Support Ticket Deflection Report: tracks week-over-week change in cashback inquiry tickets with correlation to feature adoption rate

**Existing reports affected:**
- Monthly Rewards Reconciliation Report: add column for "cashback details viewed" flag per transaction to correlate transparency with dispute rates
- Customer Support Ticket Categorization Report: add sub-category "cashback inquiry - viewed details" vs "cashback inquiry - did not view details"

**Reconciliation requirements:**
- Cashback amounts displayed in-app must reconcile with nightly rewards provisioning file (rewards earned - rewards redeemed - rewards reversed - rewards lapsed)
- Monthly cap balances shown to users must match cap tracking table updated at transaction presentment
- Exclusion reasons displayed must match MCC exclusion master list maintained by Ops team

**Data extract requirements:**
- Business Intelligence team needs daily extract of cashback_details_viewed events with transaction_id, earning_type, merchant_name, cap_status for Tableau dashboard
- Customer Support team needs weekly CSV export of transactions where user viewed Cashback Details but still contacted support (for root cause analysis)

---

## INSTRUMENTATION REQUIREMENTS:

**Event 1:**  
- **Event name:** zchs_cashback_details_viewed  
- **Trigger:** User expands "Cashback Details" section in transaction detail screen  
- **Properties:** transaction_id (string), earning_type (string: "accelerated"/"standard"/"excluded"/"reversed"), cashback_amount (number), merchant_name (string), cap_status (string: "active"/"exceeded"/"not_applicable"), latency_ms (number)  
- **Purpose:** Measure feature adoption rate and identify which earning types drive most engagement

**Event 2:**  
- **Event name:** zchs_accelerated_offer_viewed  
- **Trigger:** User taps "View offer details" link in Cashback Details section for accelerated earning  
- **Properties:** transaction_id (string), merchant_name (string), cashback_rate (number), cap_amount (number), cap_remaining (number), offer_id (string)  
- **Purpose:** Track which accelerated offers generate most user interest for future partnership prioritization

**Event 3:**  
- **Event name:** zchs_exclusion_info_viewed  
- **Trigger:** User taps info icon on "No cashback earned • [Category] excluded" message  
- **Properties:** transaction_id (string), excluded_category (string: "fuel"/"wallet_load"/"cash_advance"/"emi"/"rent"), mcc_code (string)  
- **Purpose:** Identify which exclusion categories cause most confusion to improve messaging

**Event 4:**  
- **Event name:** zchs_negative_balance_warning_viewed  
- **Trigger:** User views rewards balance screen when balance is negative  
- **Properties:** negative_balance_amount (number), days_negative (number), statement_cycles_remaining (number: 0/1/2), auto_debit_date (string)  
- **Purpose:** Monitor user awareness of negative balance consequences and predict billing disputes

**Event 5:**  
- **Event name:** zchs_cashback_details_failure  
- **Trigger:** Earning rule service fails to return data within 2-second timeout  
- **Properties:** transaction_id (string), error_code (string), error_message (string), retry_attempted (boolean), fallback_displayed (boolean)  
- **Purpose:** Track service reliability and measure impact of degraded experience on user trust

---

## SUMMARY:

- 3 use cases defined: P0 accelerated cashback display, P0 exclusion transparency, P1 reversal explanation
- Support ticket reduction: 800/month baseline → 320/month target (60% decrease) within 60 days
- Biggest assumption: Earning rule metadata API can return merchant/cap data in <300ms — needs infrastructure validation
summary: Display cashback rate earned on each transaction in transaction detail view
Show reason code for cashback rate (accelerated/standard/excluded/capped)
Link to merchant-specific earning rules when accelerated rate applies
